subject: general
question: To which state does the 'Gheriya Nritya' belong?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gujarat.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gheriya Nritya** belongs to **Gujarat **state.
 
• **Tribal **people of **Gujarat dressed **in **vibrant colored **clothing, **wearing marigold flower garland**, and** traditional jewelry** to perform** 'gheriya' folk dance**.
 
• To **worship **'**Mataji**' (goddess amba) during the **Diwali **festival.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• There are **5 **most popular **folk dances** in **Gujarat**.

 
 
• **Dandiya **most popular folk dance in **Gujarat**.
 
• **Garba**
 
• **Padhar**
 
• **Tippani**
 
• **Bhavai**
